design.name: Black Flag Envoy
design.identity: Free Captain negotiator and battlefield coordinator.
features: Choose parley or intimidation. Gain Training in Persuade (parley) or Threaten (intimidation), or Expertise if already Trained. As a Bonus Action spend one Envoy use: an ally within 30 feet who hears you may use its Reaction to move half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. You cannot target yourself.
Your Envoy action may instead let the ally repeat a saving throw against Charmed or Frightened, with advantage. On success that condition ends. Range becomes 60 feet.

Once per Long Rest, as an Action address up to your Spirit modifier (minimum one) creatures within 60 feet that understand you. Each makes an Instinct save (DC 8 + Training Bonus + Spirit). On failure it cannot attack you for one minute unless you or your allies harm it. This is Charmed; repeat the save at the end of each turn.
As a Bonus Action spend two Envoy uses to apply Terms of Surrender to up to three different allies. Each still spends its own Reaction; a creature cannot benefit twice from the same command.

features.completionRules: Binding Parley imposes Charmed plus the stated attack prohibition. Both end for an individual if you or an ally damages it or imposes a harmful condition. Repeat the save at the end of its turns. Charmed immunity prevents both effects. Crew commands require sight of the ally, hearing, a conscious ally and an available Reaction.
